obernants.operator: With finite validated inputs under ordinary IEEE-754, no traps or fast-math, nonfinite value cannot recover in v*x+c. A nonfinite derivative with finite value also cannot recover; if value later becomes nonfinite the final value gate rejects. Final finite pair therefore implies every previous pair finite. This is a scoped argument, not a Lean proof.

One final gate preserves Result variants and successful arithmetic order, but overflow may traverse remaining coefficients. Removing O(n) pair gates does not guarantee speed; input validation remains O(n).
